text_simplified: The text discusses Prophetic hadiths that highlight the virtue of al-Hasan and al-Husayn, may Allah be pleased with them both, and the love of the Prophet ﷺ for them. It also mentions some incidents that demonstrate their status among the Companions. Parents can derive the importance of raising children upon the love of Ahl al-Bayt.
